content.text:
**Defining the Task Rule**

I've been working on defining the core task rule. It boils down to creating a line of 8s (either horizontally or vertically across the grid). The 8s must have 4s (yellow) on one side and 2s (red) on the other. Activating the line will score the action. This is the central constraint.


**Refining the Grid Dimensions**

I've been drilling down on grid dimensions. The natural language description specifies 30x30, but the verifier handles rectangular grids. Smaller grids are easier for the student. Testing with different sizes, I believe the student solver only sees input/output pairs. Compact grids, like 8x8, 10x10, or 12x12, maximize clarity for the LLM solver.
